page: Microsoft Azure DC48eds_v6 is an x86_64 architecture server instance belonging to the DCEDV6 family. It features 48 dedicated vCPUs powered by an Intel processor and runs on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. The system is equipped with 192.0 GB of system memory, yielding a ratio of 4.0 GB of RAM per vCPU.

This server configuration includes a bundled local storage capacity of 2835 GB on NVMe SSDs, and it is premium storage capable. There are no integrated GPUs on this instance, and it does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the DC48eds_v6 offers a high-density resource profile, balancing a substantial dedicated core count with significant local NVMe storage. This makes the instance suitable for memory-intensive workloads, database hosting, and enterprise applications requiring fast local scratch space without the overhead of external storage.
